loiro-platinado: Platinum blonde, the lightest possible level 11-12 blonde, lifted to a pale, almost-white platinum with a neutral-cool, very slightly silvery tone and zero yellow or brassiness. Fully even from roots to ends, with the roots lightened to match so no darker regrowth shows. Soft pearly-white highlights where the light hits and subtle cool-gray shadows in the depth of the hair, keeping individual strands visible and translucent. Healthy, glossy finish of a realistic professional bleach-and-tone result.
loiro-perola: Pearl blonde, a very light level 10 blonde with a soft pearlescent violet-beige tone: a creamy off-white base with delicate iridescent lilac-pink and silvery reflections that shimmer as the light moves. Cool-neutral, never yellow and never flat gray. Even from roots to ends, with gentle multi-tonal variation between strands and a luminous, satiny, mother-of-pearl shine. Realistic professional toned-blonde result.
loiro-gelo: Icy blonde, a very light level 10 blonde with a strong cool ash tone: crisp silvery-white with a faint blue-gray, frosty sheen and absolutely no yellow, gold or warmth. Even, fully lightened color from roots to ends, with slightly cooler steel-toned shadows underneath and bright frosty highlights on top. Clean toned finish with natural strand-to-strand variation, smooth shine and a realistic professional bleach-and-toner result.
loiro-mel: Honey blonde, a warm level 7-8 blonde with a rich golden-amber tone like liquid honey. Multi-tonal: deeper amber-gold strands woven with lighter sunlit honey-gold strands, slightly deeper at the roots and glowing brighter through the mid-lengths and ends. Warm but never orange or brassy, with a glossy, luminous, healthy shine and natural strand-by-strand variation for a realistic salon-colored result.
loiro-dourado: Golden blonde, a light level 9 blonde with a clear warm golden tone, sunny and radiant like spun gold. Bright buttery-gold highlights and slightly deeper golden shadows give soft dimension, with the color even from roots to ends and the ends a touch lighter, as if sun-kissed. Saturated yet natural gold, never orange or coppery. Rich glossy shine and fine variation between strands, a realistic professional golden blonde.
loiro-bege: Beige blonde, a light level 9 blonde with a soft neutral beige tone, perfectly balanced between warm and cool: creamy sand-beige with a muted, slightly matte undertone, no yellow brassiness and no gray ash. Smooth, even color from roots to ends with subtle tonal variation between strands, softly deeper underneath and lighter on the surface. Natural satin shine for an elegant, understated and realistic salon result.
loiro-champagne: Champagne blonde, a very light level 9-10 blonde with a pale golden-beige tone and a delicate pearly-rosé shimmer, like sparkling champagne. Soft, luminous and neutral-warm: light gold and beige blended with faint pink-pearl reflections, never yellow or brassy. Even from roots to ends with fine multi-tonal strands, brighter on the surface, and a radiant, glossy shine. Realistic professional toned-blonde result.
loiro-escuro: Natural dark blonde, level 6, with a neutral tone: a soft, deep blonde that sits just above light brown, with no visible red, copper or ash. Even, believable color from roots to ends, with slightly lighter sun-touched strands on the surface and deeper tones underneath for gentle dimension. Healthy natural shine and strand-by-strand variation, looking like natural hair or an expertly matched professional color.
loiro-claro: Natural light blonde, level 8, with a neutral tone: a bright, clear blonde without visible gold, ash or red reflects. Even and luminous from roots to ends, with natural dimension from slightly lighter sun-kissed strands on the surface and softly deeper tones underneath. Soft healthy shine and realistic strand-by-strand variation, like naturally light blonde hair or a perfectly matched professional color.
loiro-medio: Natural medium blonde, level 7, with a neutral tone: a balanced, believable blonde that is neither golden nor ash, the classic natural blonde shade. Even color from roots to ends, with soft natural dimension: some strands slightly lighter on the surface and at the top, a little deeper underneath. Healthy, soft natural shine and fine variation between strands, like naturally blonde hair.
loiro-claro-acinzentado: Light ash blonde, level 8 with a clear cool ash tone: a soft, smoky, gray-tinged blonde that completely cancels yellow, gold and orange. Even from roots to ends, with slightly cooler, deeper smoky tones underneath and lighter silvery-ash strands on the surface. Muted, sophisticated and cool, yet still clearly blonde rather than gray. Smooth satin shine and realistic variation between strands.
loiro-caramelo-claro: Light caramel blonde, level 7-8 with a warm golden-copper tone like soft caramel: rich toffee-gold with a gentle hint of copper warmth, deeper at the roots and glowing lighter through the mid-lengths and ends. Multi-tonal caramel and golden strands blended seamlessly for natural dimension. Warm and luminous, but never orange or red. Glossy, healthy shine with realistic strand-to-strand variation.
loiro-manteiga: Butter blonde, a light level 9 blonde with a soft, creamy golden tone like melted butter: a gentle pale yellow-gold, warm but muted, never brassy or orange. Wide, softly blended lighter strands mixed with slightly deeper buttery-gold tones create a seamless, natural dimension from roots to ends. Luminous, smooth, creamy finish with healthy shine and realistic strand-by-strand variation.
loiro-areia: Sandy blonde, level 8 with a soft muted beige tone like dry beach sand: a blend of light beige, soft gold and a hint of cool ash that gives a natural, low-contrast, sun-faded blonde. Subtly multi-tonal, with lighter sand strands on the surface and slightly deeper beige underneath, seamlessly blended from roots to ends. Soft, velvety natural shine, no yellow brassiness, realistic and understated.
loiro-baunilha: Vanilla blonde, a very light level 10 blonde with a creamy, softly warm ivory tone like vanilla cream: pale and bright like platinum, but with a gentle buttery-cream warmth instead of icy coolness. Even from roots to ends, with subtle golden-cream and ivory strands blended together for soft dimension. Smooth, luminous, silky shine, never brassy yellow, a realistic toned salon blonde.
loiro-clarissimo: Natural very light blonde, level 9 with a neutral tone: a bright, luminous blonde that is light and clean without an obvious golden, ash or platinum effect. Even from roots to ends, with soft natural dimension from slightly paler strands on the surface and marginally deeper tones underneath. Healthy, soft shine and realistic strand-by-strand variation, like naturally very fair blonde hair.
loiro-escandinavo: Pale, airy natural white-blonde, a very light level 10 blonde with a soft neutral-cool tone: slightly translucent white-blonde with faint creamy-beige undertones and the effortless look of naturally very fair hair. Subtle dimension, with barely deeper roots softly melted into luminous pale mid-lengths and ends, and fine brighter strands on the surface. No yellow and no heavy gray ash. Soft natural sheen and realistic strand-by-strand variation.
loiro-bronde: Bronde, a seamless blend of light brown and dark blonde: a level 6 soft brown base woven with many fine level 8 golden-beige blonde strands, so the hair reads as neither fully brunette nor fully blonde. Slightly deeper at the roots and gradually more blonde through the mid-lengths and ends, with soft caramel-beige transitions and no harsh stripes. Natural multi-tonal dimension, glossy healthy shine, realistic salon result.
loiro-escuro-acinzentado: Dark ash blonde, level 6-7 with a cool ash tone: a deep, smoky blonde with gray-taupe coolness that fully cancels red, copper and golden warmth. Even color from roots to ends, with slightly lighter cool silvery-ash strands on the surface and deeper smoky tones underneath for soft dimension. Muted, matte-leaning and sophisticated with a subtle satin shine, a realistic dyed result with natural strand variation.
loiro-extra-claro: Natural extra-light blonde, level 10 with a neutral tone: a very pale, bright blonde close to platinum but softer and more natural, with a faint natural warmth rather than an icy or white effect. Even from roots to ends, the roots matched with no regrowth line, and gentle tonal variation between strands. Soft, luminous, healthy shine and a realistic lightened salon result.
loiro-escuro-dourado: Dark golden blonde, level 6 with a warm golden tone: a deep, rich blonde that sits just above light brown, glowing with soft gold reflections in the light. Even from roots to ends, with deeper golden-brown tones underneath and lighter warm-gold strands on the surface for natural dimension. Warm but not copper, orange or red. Glossy, healthy shine and realistic strand-by-strand variation.
loiro-nude: Soft rosy-beige blonde, a light level 9 blonde with a muted beige tone and a faint warm rosy-peach undertone: understated, creamy and low-contrast, neither golden nor ash, and never obviously pink. Seamless, even color from roots to ends with gentle tonal variation between strands and a slightly lighter surface. Soft satin shine, delicate and natural-looking, a realistic toned salon blonde.
loiro-ouro-rose: Rose gold blonde, a light level 9 blonde tinted with a soft metallic rose-gold tone: warm golden blonde blended with delicate blush-pink and peachy-rose reflections. Slightly deeper rose-gold at the roots, melting into lighter pink-champagne mid-lengths and ends. Pastel and wearable, clearly pinkish-gold but not hot pink or red. Shimmering, glossy metallic shine and natural strand-by-strand variation, a realistic professional toned color.
loiro-trigo: Wheat blonde, level 8 with a warm golden-beige tone like ripe wheat: a natural mix of soft gold, light beige and a few slightly deeper honey-tan strands. Multi-tonal and sun-kissed, a little deeper at the roots and lighter through the mid-lengths and ends, with no brassy orange and no ash. Natural, healthy shine and realistic strand-to-strand variation for an effortless, sunlit blonde.
loiro-sujo: Dirty blonde, a natural level 7 blonde made of mixed darker and lighter strands: muted dark-blonde, light-brown and soft golden-beige pieces blended into a lived-in, slightly darker, unpolished blonde. Deeper at the roots and underneath, with lighter strands scattered through the mid-lengths and surface, softly blended with no stripes. Neutral tone, neither brassy nor ashy, with a natural sheen and realistic strand-by-strand variation.
loiro-cogumelo: Mushroom blonde, a level 7 blonde with an earthy, muted taupe tone: a blend of cool ash, soft beige and a faint smoky mauve, like the color of a mushroom cap. Multi-tonal, with deeper taupe-brown tones near the roots and underneath, and lighter ash-beige strands through the mid-lengths, ends and surface. Low-contrast, velvety and cool-neutral, with no red or golden warmth. Soft satin shine and realistic strand-by-strand variation.
loiro-lilas: Lilac blonde, a very light level 10 blonde tinted with a soft, translucent lilac-lavender tone: pale pearly blonde with gentle violet-pink reflections that read as a subtle pastel wash, still clearly blonde rather than purple. Slightly deeper lavender tint near the roots and underneath, lighter silvery-lilac through the mid-lengths, ends and surface. Cool, dreamy and delicate, with a soft pearly shine and realistic variation between strands.
